title: More Death Messages
description: Unique death messages and consistent message ids
body:
- Changes damage type files to have consistent format (all snake case)
- Gives each damage type it's own message id for death messages in lang files
- Gives new message ids their own messages, including death by wind charge, campfire, ender pearl, and llama spit

Curently only works with en-us language. May break other languages or other packs.
